# Support & Community Resources — GLASTOR® zerho

To ensure maximum operational reliability and developer experience (DX) excellence across the **GLASTOR Core** ecosystem, official support channels for **zerho** (`https://github.com/glastor-core/jester`) are organized by inquiry type below.

---

## Architecture & Community Discussions

Use this space for questions on migrating from Vite (`zerho migrate`), configuring `zerho.toml`, authoring Rust → `.wasm` plugins (`zerho:plugin@0.1.0`), Edge SSR deployments (`zerho build --ssr`), remote `redb` team caches, or benchmark methodology:

- **[zerho GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/glastor-core/jester/discussions)**
  - *Best for:* Architecture questions, migration guides, plugin authoring, and roadmap feedback.
- **Official Portal & Documentation:** [zerho.xyz](https://zerho.xyz)

---

## Bug Reports & Feature Requests

If you encounter a transform edge case in `oxc`/`lightningcss`, a resolver issue with `node_modules` CJS/ESM packages, HMR regressions, or want to propose a new web platform feature:

- **[Open a GitHub Issue](https://github.com/glastor-core/jester/issues)**
- **Best Practice:** Provide a minimal reproducible repository or snippet, your `zerho --version`, `zerho.toml`, and target operating system.

---

## Confidential Security Inquiries

For reporting security vulnerabilities, sandbox bypasses, or dev/preview server security flaws, **do not open public issues**:

1. Review our **[Security Policy](https://github.com/glastor-core/jester/security/policy)**.
2. Submit a report via **[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/glastor-core/jester/security/advisories/new)** or email **[founder@glastor.es](mailto:founder@glastor.es)**.
